newsitem.title: USA: National Affiliated to buy World Service.
newsitem.headline: National Affiliated to buy World Service.

text.p: The majority shareholder of National Affiliated Corp has signed a definitive agreement to buy World Service Life Insurance Co, a company statement said on Monday.

The statement released by National Affiliated said the owner of 55 percent of its stock, Southern Group Inc, had signed an agreement to acquire 100 percent of World Service, which is based in Alabama.
The acquisition will boost total assets to 350 percent and triple premium income, it said.
It will also widen National Affiliated's coverage to 44 U.S. states from 17, the statement said.
